rows.label: Vox Solaris quest
rows.note: opens the Ventkids, Roky's shop and races, and gives the K-Drive Launcher

rows.label: Heart of Deimos quest
rows.note: starting it opens the Cambion Drift, where the Feverspine race runs

conditions: The free Bondi K-Drive from Vox Solaris cannot be modded or leveled and grants no Mastery
Only 5 of the 8 Cambion Drift races are active at a time and the set changes at the daily reset, so check the map on a K-Drive for Dead Drop
A Cambion Drift race only drops its part while you hold no blueprint for it; owning the built board does not block a repeat
bonuses: The race also pays Ventkids standing like any other

disclosures.title: the Infested reactor, nose and jet
disclosures.body: Other Cambion Drift races drop Gristlebuck (reactor), Nodulite (nose) and Steeba (jet) for no standing. Building the Feverspine on those instead of Roky's Neutral parts saves 15,000 Ventkids standing, at the cost of waiting on the race rotation and farming Deimos materials: Gristlebuck 20 Pustulite, 10 Ocular Stem-Root, 40 Tempered Bapholite, 10 Pustulent Cognitive Nodule; Nodulite 5 Stellated Necrathene, 30 Ganglion, 5 Ocular Stem-Root, 10 Sporulate Sac; Steeba 35 Pustulite, 25 Parasitic Tethermaw, 10 Goblite Tears, 20 Saturated Muscle Mass; 5,000 cr each.

rows.label: Ventkids standing
rows.note: 240,000 of it burns on rank-ups to Logical, 80,000 buys blueprints

conditions: Each rank-up sacrifices the full standing of the rank you leave, so Logical costs 240,000 earned before anything is bought
Ventkids rank-ups take no resources or credits, only standing
Every rank-up grants one free item of that rank's wares; take the board at Whozit, Primo and Logical and those three boards cost no standing

groups.activity: buy the board and part blueprints

rows.label: Flatbelly Blueprint
rows.alt: or free as the Whozit rank-up pick

rows.label: Needlenose Blueprint
rows.alt: or free as the Primo rank-up pick

rows.label: Runway Blueprint
rows.alt: or free as the Logical rank-up pick

conditions: Only the board earns Mastery; reactor, nose and jet are purely cosmetic, so the cheapest Neutral three go on every build
Roky sells four boards: Bad Baby at Neutral, Flatbelly at Whozit, Needlenose at Primo, Runway at Logical. Feverspine is race-only

disclosures.title: the other parts Roky sells
disclosures.body: Reactors: Coldfusor (Neutral, 5,000), Arc Twelve (Whozit, 10,000), Hothead (Primo, 15,000), Highbrow (Logical, 15,000). Noses: Beaky, Wingnut, Dink-A-Donk, Two-Sloops at the same ranks and prices. Jets: Twin Kavats, Step Tens, Fatboys, Thugs likewise. None of them changes stats or Mastery.

rows.note: one per board, each with a reactor, nose and jet

conditions: No gilding: each board banks 200 Mastery per rank, 6,000 at rank 30
Your first assembled K-Drive replaces the Bondi, and the last K-Drive you own can never be sold
bonuses: Roky's Daily Special sells one randomly assembled K-Drive for platinum, worth a look only on a day it rolls a board you lack
